text: Seabrook Town's tactical adjustment to a 3-4-3 with wide crossing play triggered an increase in final third entries (8 in 8 minutes), demonstrating effective wing overloads to stretch Harbour City's 4-2-3-1 defense. Their pressing intensity (ppda 9.0) disrupted Harbour City's build-up, leading to moderate possession (47.1%) and a high pass accuracy (88.0%), enabling sustained attacking sequences rather than hurried clearances. Although their two shots on target reflect offensive pressure, the low xG (0.1) and absence of big chances indicate that Harbour City's patient short passing and defensive rest strategies maintain control despite Seabrook’s momentum shift. Harbour City's higher xG (1.3) and big chance creation in the same period underscore their continued threat on transition and counter. Overall, Seabrook’s tactical mechanism centers on triggering wide overloads and pressing to tilt the field (60%) and reclaim control, yet execution remains insufficient to overturn the deficit[#935] [#1056].
